text: {"assertions":["A plan drift issue in the VPC module (infra/terraform/vpc.tf) was discovered on 2026-01-27 after a rolling restart of the fleet.","The plan drift was caused by floating point rounding in the money path calculation.","The fix involved moving arithmetic to integer minor units and was submitted as PR #8605 on branch fix/plan-drift-1.","The plan drift manifested as unexpected diffs appearing on resources that had not been edited.","The issue could be reproduced by running terraform plan twice in succession with no intervening changes.","The terraform plan check in CI serves as the covering check for this infrastructure.","Memory usage improved from climbing past 4 GB to settling at 532 MB after implementing the fix.","The infrastructure code is written in HCL (Terraform)."]}
